entries.zh: 受屈吃苦；忍受劳苦委屈
entries.en: to suffer wrongs and hardships; to endure toil humbly

entries.zh: 气量高宏，极能容受；很能忍耐
entries.en: of lofty, capacious tolerance; long-suffering, greatly forbearing
entries.notes: 西语栏 "mui supido" 拼写可疑（疑为 muy sufrido 之类转写讹误），据汉字"高量"定为气量高宏、极能容受之义。

entries.zh: 宽泰安舒，心平能忍；宽缓不迫、宽容大量
entries.en: calm, easy-tempered and forbearing; at ease under suffering

entries.zh: 宽宏大量，胸襟宽阔有气度；有精神能容受
entries.en: magnanimous, broad-minded; to bear much with spirit

entries.zh: 宽宏有量，容受宏阔；有心胸能忍
entries.en: of broad, capacious tolerance; to bear much with heart

entries.zh: 气量宏大，有大肚量；有魄力能容
entries.en: great magnanimity, large capacity of mind; to endure much with vigour

entries.zh: 忍住不说，闭口不言；受屈不吭声
entries.en: to hold one's tongue; to endure without speaking
entries.notes: 汉字栏"忍/思"存疑、西语词尾 r/n 存疑，据四栏对勘取"忍口"之义为忍住不说、闭口受屈。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏删除线字难辨且标[残]，汉字"縱/從"存疑，仅能辨"縱裕"二字、疑为宽纵宽裕之义，材料不足，待复核原件。

entries.zh: 忍气，受辱而容忍不发
entries.en: to swallow one's anger; to bear insults with tolerance
entries.notes: 首字"忍/思"存疑，据汉字栏与西语释义（受辱而容忍）取"忍气"之义。

entries.zh: 气量如海，极能容受；受而不怒
entries.en: ocean-like capacity; to bear everything without anger

entries.zh: 如海含容，涵量宏阔；容受宏大
entries.en: to hold and contain as the sea; vast forbearance

entries.zh: 如海纳百川，无所不容
entries.en: to receive all as the sea does; all-embracing tolerance

entries.zh: 含容忍让，宽涵包容
entries.en: to contain, tolerate and bear with; forbearance

entries.zh: 宽饶不较，饶恕容让而宽裕
entries.en: lenient, forgiving and generous; to bear with readily

entries.zh: 忍让，受而不报；退让不争
entries.en: to forbear and yield; to endure without taking revenge
entries.notes: 首字"忍/思"存疑，据汉字栏与西语释义（不加报复）取"忍让"之义。

entries.zh: 能够容忍，容得下、忍得住；能忍受并宽恕
entries.en: able to bear and forgive; capable of tolerance
entries.notes: 首字"忍/思"存疑，据汉字栏"会容忍得"与西语释义（忍受并宽恕）定夺。

entries.zh: 承担艰难困苦，忍受磨难
entries.en: to bear hardship and suffer affliction; to endure toil

entries.zh: 志意郁结，愁闷抑郁；郁郁不乐
entries.en: dejected and melancholy; pent-up frustration
entries.notes: 西语栏残损无法复原（标[残]），首字"郁/欝"存疑，据汉字"郁志"定为愁闷抑郁之义。

entries.zh: 中流砥柱，喻坚立不摇、能承受诸般劳苦
entries.en: pillar standing firm in the stream; steadfast under constant toils
entries.notes: 西语栏中段残损难辨（标[残]），据汉字"砥柱"取中流砥柱、坚忍不摇之义。

entries.zh: 能够忍耐，忍得住；可以忍受
entries.en: it can be endured; able to bear it
entries.notes: 首字"忍/思"存疑，据汉字栏"会忍得"与西语释义（可以忍受）定夺。

entries.zh: 忍气吞声，强自忍受；彼此相容
entries.en: to endure in silence; to bear with one another
entries.notes: 首字"忍/思"存疑，据汉字栏"吞忍"与西语释义（互相忍受）定夺。

entries.zh: 相忍，彼此容忍；互相退让
entries.en: to bear with one another; mutual forbearance
entries.notes: 首字"忍/思"存疑，据汉字栏"相忍"与西语释义（彼此容忍）定夺。
